crime_highlights: you stabbed Mr. Blosser repeatedly, causing his death
rationale_highlights: your background was chaotic and dysfunctional, fraught with abuse and neglect
You had no stable or loving home, and you had no opportunity to learn your traditional language or to practice traditional spiritual beliefs
In all the circumstances, I accept counsel's joint submission that a sentence of seven years' imprisonment is the appropriate sentence
note: Gladue factors only in joint submission; court finds blameworthiness high, never states mitigation

crime_highlights: Mr. Williams then returned to the basement, where his sleeping quarters were located, armed with a chef's knife from the kitchen.
Shortly thereafter, Mr. Thomas was stabbed by Mr. Williams.
The pathology evidence revealed one wound in the side of Mr. Thomas's torso to a depth of approximately six inches.
Mr. Thomas died in hospital approximately three hours later.
rationale_highlights: Mr. Williams' parents endured residential schooling and battles with alcoholism
the exposure of his parents to the residential school system and the consequent struggles of many Nuu-chah-nulth people with family violence and abuse and substance misuse
the disposition jointly urged upon me is within the range of fit sentences for the offence committed by an offender in Mr. Williams' circumstances
note: Court says factors give context only; accepts joint submission without stating mitigating effect

crime_highlights: The accused, Preston Paul, has pleaded guilty to the sexual assault of his 16-year-old niece.
the victim was supplied liquor by the accused at a house party
rationale_highlights: Mr. Paul is the product of a highly dysfunctional aboriginal family which can be identified as having been the product of destructive historical systemic treatment
I am mindful of the over-representation of aboriginal offenders in jails in this country and the progress that Mr. Paul has made while in remand custody
note: Court notes s. 718.2(e) relevant but weighs Gladue para 79; no stated reduction
